# HPKE base-mode known-answer tests for the two ML-KEM suites ACCP curates.
#
# Provenance: extracted from AWS-LC tag v5.11.0, which includes 3b4b08959 (aws-lc#3277), file
# crypto/hpke/hpke_test_vectors_pq.txt, which holds the draft-ietf-hpke-pq-05 vectors. They are
# draft-sourced and may churn with the draft.
#
# Extraction: the kem_id 65 and 66 blocks, keeping mode, the three ids, info, skRm, pkRm, ikmE,
# enc and all ten encryptions (aad_N, ct_N, pt_N use sequence number N, contiguous from 0). The
# exports are omitted because ACCP has no exporter API, and the kem_id 64 block is not curated.
# Ids are decimal, as in the source.
#
# Quirk: info and every pt_N are the hex encoding of an ASCII hex string (the draft's vectors are
# double encoded), and the ciphertexts cover those literal bytes. For example, the info value
# 3466363436... decodes to the text "4f646520...".
[HPKE base mode]
